name: Blood Midnight Blossom
source:
The main character is an ordinary girl named Annihilation, who lives in a small town A. She inherits a huge debt from her father and is desperate to find a way out. On the street, she meets a stranger in a raincoat, called Catharsis, who offers a demonic part-time job for a week.

Catharsis is a vampire who lives in a world hidden from the eyes of ordinary people. For hundreds of years she has been looking after this city and does not mind lending a helping hand to it’s inhabitant. But there is one problem – the existence of Catharsis is coming to an end, her soul is decaying and in a week she will die in case she cannot ascend to her ancestors. To do this, she needs a human guide who will extract demonic energy for the ritual. Annihilation finds their agreement fair and agrees.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2503260/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人公是个名叫Annihilation的普通女孩，住在A小镇。她继承了父亲的巨额债务，急切地寻找出路。在街上，她遇见一位穿雨衣的陌生人Catharsis，对方提供了一份为期一周、与恶魔有关的兼职。

Catharsis是一名吸血鬼，生活在常人视线之外的世界。数百年来，她一直照看着这座城市，也不介意向居民伸出援手。但有一个问题：她的存在即将走到尽头，灵魂正在腐朽。如果无法升至祖先身边，一周后，她便会死去。为此，她需要一名人类向导，提取仪式所需的恶魔能量。Annihilation觉得这份协议公平，便答应了。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2503260/]Steam[/url]]
